items.title: Cody Gakpo chooses Manchester City
items.facebook:
🔴 BREAKING: Cody Gakpo has decided he wants to join Manchester City.

Manchester City have opened talks with Liverpool and discussions are also under way over personal terms. The move is now advancing in City's direction, with Gakpo choosing City amid interest from Tottenham.

Nothing is signed yet — the clubs still need to reach an agreement.

Via David Ornstein

💬 Would Liverpool be right to sell Gakpo?
